C0440.title: Analysis of Emerging Credential Stuffing Attacks Involving AI Agents
C0440.summary: Security researchers have observed early fraud patterns leveraging AI agents for credential stuffing as AI-driven traffic surges. Attackers may use AI agents to simulate human behavior, automating the validation and testing of stolen credit card information to bypass traditional rule-based detection mechanisms, marking an evolution in credential stuffing techniques.

references.title: AI Agents and Fraud: Early Evidence of Carding Behavior in the Wild
